description: arXiv:2609.05701v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One of the biggest risks faced by Software Defined Networks (SDN) is the Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack in which a compromised controller can make an entire network unusable. To address these challenges, we suggest an entropy-guided machine learning framework, called XAI-SDN, for real-time DDoS detection in SDN environments which is...
